query_analysis.original_query: Provide the standard droplet size cut-off for mist eliminators in demisters.
query_analysis.expanded_query: Determine the typical droplet size range that mist eliminators in demisters are designed to remove from the gas stream.

clarification_questions: Are there any specific operating conditions (pressure, temperature, gas velocity) for the demister?
What is the composition of the gas stream being treated by the demister?
